Iraq dig site of Merrin's opening confrontation.

How Nineveh connects

  • Character: Father Lankester Merrin — Merrin's prologue confrontation happens at the Nineveh dig.
  • Character: Pazuzu — The Pazuzu image is unearthed at Nineveh.

What is Nineveh?

Nineveh is the archaeological site of the film's prologue, where Merrin finds the Pazuzu amulet and feels the coming fight.

Key threads lead to Father Lankester Merrin and Pazuzu.
